requirements.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP port 8080.
requirements.summary: nginx was active and listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8080. Both the help index and nested help document returned HTTP 200 with bodies matching the staged source, including after the node restart.

requirements.requirement: Permanently redirect old /manual URLs to the corresponding /help URLs while retaining the remaining path and query string.
requirements.summary: Direct tests returned HTTP 301 for /manual, /manual/, and a nested manual URL. The nested path and complete query string were preserved, and following the redirect produced the matching staged help document. The same behavior recovered after restart.

requirements.requirement: Return the supplied /status.txt document directly, without redirecting it.
requirements.summary: /status.txt, including a request carrying a query string, returned HTTP 200 rather than a redirect, and its response body matched the supplied status document before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the platform.
requirements.summary: The node remained Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic across execution and restart. nginx was installed from the Ubuntu Noble repository without upgrading existing packages, and package consistency remained healthy.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct functional evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for node1: a healthy pre-restart state and boot identity were captured, the reboot was acknowledged, the post-restart identity differed, and service, content, redirect behavior, listening state, and platform state recovered. The fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the transition.
limitations: Minor evidence artifacts remained in /tmp, and the /var/tmp boot-identity marker was not demonstrated as removed; this affects hygiene but not functionality.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had a clear task or mandatory restart-evidence purpose: installing nginx, deploying and enabling its site configuration, removing the conflicting default site, and performing the required reboot. No failed services or package damage remained. Minor residue was left from evidence collection: /tmp/post-status, /tmp/post-help, and /tmp/post-follow remained after the final checks, and the reboot marker created at /var/tmp/help-site-boot-before was not shown cleaned up. These were bounded, low-risk artifacts rather than unrelated troubleshooting mutations.
